Common Questions

FAQ

Helpful details before speaking with Glen.

Who is Lifestyle Consultancy for?
It is for adults who want structured support to become more active, improve daily routines, strengthen confidence, or make progress toward personal and professional goals.
Is the programme personalised?
Yes. Guidance is shaped around your current lifestyle, priorities, schedule, and the outcomes you want to pursue.
Is this a medical or clinical service?
No. Lifestyle Consultancy is a non-regulated coaching and consultancy service. It does not diagnose, treat, or replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional.
How do I arrange an initial conversation?
Call or message Glen Apostol on +971 56 664 4147 to discuss your goals and the most suitable next step.
